headline: Two outreach workers and more litter help at Cotton Street referred for FY28 budget.
summary: The referral covers two more outreach workers and about a half-time public works position for litter and trash. The assistant city manager estimated roughly $10,000 for additional containers. Staff will look at options for a more permanent location and bring them back to a future meeting. Staff is also drafting a charge for a task force on unsheltered homelessness and public safety, due in January.
decisions: Referred Cotton Street outreach and litter staffing to the Finance Committee for FY28 budget consideration.
discussion: Cotton Street site: Public speakers gave mixed views, with one calling for an indoor day space downtown and another saying the current site is effective in the short term.

Homelessness task force: Staff will draft a charge and narrow the policy goals. Members debated whether affected residents and businesses should serve on the task force, and suggested an academic partner such as the Cutler Institute.

Before and after care lottery: Parks staff proposed a lottery to divide spots fairly, with registration open for at least six weeks from early April and the lottery held in mid-May. Staff said spots are set aside for fee waivers and McKinney-Vento students.

Police staffing: The police chief reported 26 vacancies out of 158 budgeted positions, plus two pending retirements in December. The chief estimated close to 200 officers would be needed to do everything the department should.
Winter warming shelter: Staff said nine people are lined up for interviews this week and a staffing fair is planned for early next week, ahead of the December 15th opening date.

decision_evidence.quote: So moved. Second. Moved by Councillor Palacier, seconded by Councillor McKnivich. Councillor Palacier, how do you vote? Yes. Councillor McKnivich. Yes. I'm a yes. We have voted to move this item to finance for consideration for the fiscal impact for the next budget year.

decision_titles: Cotton Street outreach and litter help for FY28 budget
